description.en: Array of catalog items: [{"id":"...","type":"service","required":true,"minimumTermDays":365,"choiceGroup":"billing"}]. Use type productVariation for a product variation. Optional minimumTermDays sets a minimum term in days (e.g. 365 = 12 months) for recurring items. Items sharing the same choiceGroup are mutually exclusive alternatives, such as monthly or yearly billing; the client picks exactly one, the item with the lowest position is preselected, and all items in a group must have the same required value with at least two items.
description.de: Liste von Katalogpositionen: [{"id":"...","type":"service","required":true,"minimumTermDays":365,"choiceGroup":"billing"}]. Für Produktvarianten type productVariation verwenden. Optionales minimumTermDays legt eine Mindestlaufzeit in Tagen fest (z. B. 365 = 12 Monate) für wiederkehrende Positionen. Positionen mit derselben choiceGroup sind sich gegenseitig ausschließende Alternativen, etwa monatliche oder jährliche Abrechnung; der Kunde wählt genau eine aus, die Position mit dem niedrigsten position-Wert ist vorausgewählt, und alle Positionen einer Gruppe müssen denselben required-Wert haben, wobei mindestens zwei nötig sind.
description.es: Lista de elementos del catálogo: [{"id":"...","type":"service","required":true,"minimumTermDays":365,"choiceGroup":"billing"}]. Usa productVariation para una variante de producto. El minimumTermDays opcional define una permanencia mínima en días (por ejemplo, 365 = 12 meses) para elementos recurrentes. Los elementos con el mismo choiceGroup son alternativas mutuamente excluyentes, como facturación mensual o anual; el cliente elige exactamente una, se preselecciona el elemento con la position más baja y todos los elementos del grupo deben tener el mismo valor required con al menos dos en total.
description.fr: Liste d'éléments du catalogue : [{"id":"...","type":"service","required":true,"minimumTermDays":365,"choiceGroup":"billing"}]. Utilise productVariation pour une variante de produit. Le minimumTermDays facultatif définit une durée minimale en jours (par exemple 365 = 12 mois) pour les éléments récurrents. Les éléments partageant le même choiceGroup sont des alternatives mutuellement exclusives, comme une facturation mensuelle ou annuelle ; le client en choisit exactement une, l'élément avec la position la plus basse est présélectionné et tous les éléments d'un groupe doivent avoir la même valeur required avec au moins deux éléments.
description.it: Elenco di elementi del catalogo: [{"id":"...","type":"service","required":true,"minimumTermDays":365,"choiceGroup":"billing"}]. Usa productVariation per una variante di prodotto. Il minimumTermDays facoltativo imposta una durata minima in giorni (ad esempio 365 = 12 mesi) per gli elementi ricorrenti. Gli elementi con lo stesso choiceGroup sono alternative mutuamente esclusive, come la fatturazione mensile o annuale; il cliente ne sceglie esattamente una, l'elemento con la position più bassa è preselezionato e tutti gli elementi di un gruppo devono avere lo stesso valore required con almeno due elementi.
description.ro: Listă de elemente din catalog: [{"id":"...","type":"service","required":true,"minimumTermDays":365,"choiceGroup":"billing"}]. Folosește productVariation pentru o variantă de produs. minimumTermDays opțional stabilește o durată minimă în zile (de exemplu 365 = 12 luni) pentru elementele recurente. Elementele cu același choiceGroup sunt alternative care se exclud reciproc, cum ar fi facturarea lunară sau anuală; clientul alege exact una, elementul cu cea mai mică position este preselectat, iar toate elementele dintr-un grup trebuie să aibă aceeași valoare required și să fie cel puțin două.

en: Turn a discovery call into a scoped client proposal
Keep foundational services required while offering useful upgrades
Create a formal quote only after the client confirms
de: Ein Gespräch in ein klares Kundenangebot überführen
Grundlagen fix halten und passende Erweiterungen anbieten
Ein verbindliches Angebot erst nach der Kundenbestätigung erstellen

en.question: Can a client remove every item from a proposal?
en.answer: No. Items marked as required always remain included; only optional scope can be changed.

en.question: When is the formal quote created?
en.answer: Only when the client confirms their chosen scope. It is then emailed to the contact immediately.

de.question: Kann ein Kunde alle Positionen abwählen?
de.answer: Nein. Als erforderlich markierte Positionen bleiben immer enthalten; nur optionale Leistungen sind wählbar.

de.question: Wann wird das verbindliche Angebot erstellt?
de.answer: Erst wenn der Kunde den gewählten Umfang bestätigt. Danach wird es sofort per E-Mail versendet.

warp.name: JoAi: Update Site

description.en: Update a site’s enabled state, name, URL, custom domain, type (undefined|shop), contact, metrics source/resource, or monthly report schedule.
description.de: Aktualisiert Aktivierung, Name, URL, eigene Domain, Typ (undefined|shop), Kontakt, Metrik-Quelle/-Ressource oder Monatsbericht einer Website.

warp.bot: Update site fields including optional type and custom domain. customDomain sets the site’s own bare hostname (e.g. example.com, no protocol) and must be unique across teams. type=shop requires url, only works on brandless sites, and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team). Pass type=undefined (or empty) to clear shop. For metricsSource=analytics, pass analyticsDomains as the public hostname JSON array; metricsResource is optional because JoAi generates a site key when needed. For Cloudflare and Google Search Console, pass metricsResource as the zone tag or property URL. monthlyReport=true opts into the 1st-of-month job when contact and metrics are set — it does not send immediately. Native analytics needs no third-party integration. If another source returns channel_not_configured, call settings-integration-open with its integration, then retry.
